title: Prescribed Lelong Numbers for One-Pole Green Functions on Complex Projective Space
summary: Let $ω_{\mathrm{FS}}$ be the normalized Fubini--Study form on $\mathbf P^n$, with $n\geq2$. We prove that the one-pole Lelong-number range in $DMA(\mathbf P^n,ω_{\mathrm{FS}})$ is exactly $[0,1]$: for every $λ$ in this interval there is a Green function with a single pole, Monge--Ampère measure equal to the Dirac mass at that pole, and Lelong number $λ$. This answers Question~9 in the survey of Dinew--Guedj--Zeriahi, where the problem is attributed to Coman and Guedj.
